name: Follow That Kobold!

angles.text: This task introduces Tordrin Sternblade, a veteran hunter trainer newly arrived from Ironforge to assist Northshire Abbey.
Tordrin Sternblade brings traditional dwarven tracking expertise straight from Ironforge to help the humans of Northshire.
Cooperation between Stormwind's holy abbey and an Ironforge mountaineer highlights the strength of the Alliance's mutual support.

faq.answer: Follow That Kobold! is a quest in Northshire Valley tasked with pursuing a rogue kobold who fled the local mine carrying a heavy sack of stolen books belonging to Brother Paxton.
faq.q: What is Follow That Kobold! about?

faq.answer: Tordrin Sternblade is a dwarven Hunter trainer recently arrived from Ironforge. He is stationed behind Northshire Abbey near the stables and lends his tracking expertise to help recover the stolen books.

According to reports from Kelsey, a kobold slipped out of the Northshire mine hauling a large sack of books. The abbey needs them retrieved on behalf of Brother Paxton, though why a kobold would covet human tomes remains a mystery.
Kelsey Fargo is the new mining apprentice who works right outside the Northshire mine. She first noticed the unusual sight of a kobold departing the tunnels with a sack stuffed with books.
Brother Paxton is a cleric residing at Northshire Abbey. The stolen library materials belong to him or his sacred duties, prompting the call for an experienced tracker to get them back.

aliases: how do i track the kobold
faq.answer: Rather than charging blindly into the woods, adventurers are sent to consult Tordrin Sternblade behind the abbey, who prepares tracking techniques to follow the thief's trail.
faq.q: How do you track the thieving kobold?

sections.body: Just when the workers and clerics of Northshire Abbey believed the vermin problem in the mines was under control, an unusual report arrived from Kelsey: a lone kobold was spotted fleeing the tunnels hauling a heavy sack of books. The stolen volumes belong to Brother Paxton, who urgently requires their return to the abbey's collection.
sections.title: The Book Thief of Northshire

sections.body: Tracking a nimble subterranean scavenger through the wooded grounds of Northshire requires specialized skill. To find the thief, adventurers are directed behind the abbey to the stables to seek out Tordrin Sternblade, a dwarven Hunter trainer newly arrived from Ironforge who possesses the wilderness knowledge needed to pick up the scent.
sections.title: Calling in the Mountaineer

summary: Follow That Kobold! is an Alliance quest in Northshire Valley dealing with a bizarre theft from the local mines. A kobold has fled with a sack of Brother Paxton's books, prompting the abbey to recruit the dwarven hunter trainer Tordrin Sternblade to assist in tracking the thief.
